title: Smoke Alarm Dhuan Sunta Nahi, Phir Bhi Kaise Bajta Hai? 🤔 #shorts
description:
Smoke alarm na dhuan sunta hai, na smell karta hai, phir bhi raat ko kaise bajta hai? Is video mein andar ka poora raaz hai.
🔥 Alarm dhuan ke kan (particles) pakadta hai, garmi ya smell nahi
⚡ Ionization type mein current kaise girta hai
💡 Photoelectric type mein light kaise bikharti hai
🔔 Buzzer kab aur kaise bajta hai
📅 Alarm kitne saal baad badalna chahiye
Aise aur videos ke liye subscribe karein!
#shorts #smokealarm #smokedetector #howitworks #electronics #hindi
